title: Length includes a power head, two wheelchair spaces
why: Table 5 uses the unit length 'excluding the locomotive or power head'. At 210 m 3 spaces are needed, at 205 m or less 2: the true length is unknown.

spec.name: Length includes a power head, two wheelchair spaces

wheelchair_spaces.required: ≥ 2 or ≥ 3 depending on the length without the power head
wheelchair_spaces.rationale: 4.2.2.2(1) counts the length 'excluding the locomotive or power head'. The stated 210 m includes it, so the true length is ≤ 210 m: it needs 3 spaces if above 205 m and 2 if not. The spec cannot settle it.
